scripts.build: pnpm --filter @pump-fun/pump-sdk build && pnpm --filter @pump-reconstruction/backend build && pnpm --filter @pump-reconstruction/frontend build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @pump-reconstruction/backend test && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && pnpm test:explore && pnpm test:feed && pnpm test:profile && pnpm test:references && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_capture*.py" && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_verify_evidence.py"
scripts.test:references: python3 scripts/extract-reference-pages.py --check && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_reference_pages.py && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/reference_pages.test.ts
scripts.check:progress: python3 scripts/progress.py --check && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_progress.py"
